reviews.title: Cheap large storage devices, not the fastest thing out there
reviews.comment: I'm using 3 of these in a Proxmox server for VM and data storage. They work decently. A bit more noisy than your normal disk drive, but to be expected since these are enterprise drives. Read speeds are good, write speeds vary wildly depending on application. Write performance of these drives can be downright painful at times if you use ZFS with them as I had to do, but when you don't want to shell out for enterprise SSDs...
